description_en: Pauses the playback of a video file during a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件时，暂停视频播放
name: PauseVideoFile

parameters.description_en: The call ID. Get the CallId from the return parameters of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) interface.
